description.value: The Big Lake Branch is a small community library serving the rural Big Lake Ranch area in BC's Cariboo region, operating as one of 15 branches of the Cariboo Regional District Library. It provides access to books, eBooks, audiobooks, online databases, and community programming for residents and visitors in this remote interior location. For touring cyclists passing through this sparsely populated stretch of the Cariboo, it represents a rare publicly accessible facility with a named community librarian on site.

address.value: 4056 Lakeview Rd, Big Lake Ranch, BC, V0L 1G0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and is the primary evidence source. The branch page confirms the library is open at 4056 Lakeview Rd, Big Lake Ranch, BC, with a phone number of 1-866-691-1306 — this differs from the OSM tag (+1-250-243-2355), so I use the website value and flag the discrepancy. No amenities such as bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill are mentioned anywhere in the website content; the OSM internet_access=wlan tag cannot be treated as authoritative without website corroboration, so Wi-Fi is left null.
